The Negative Particle remains unchanged in - 1. नभ्राज् 2. नपात् 3. नवेदस् 4. नासत्या (dual) 5. नमुचि 6. नकुल 7. नख 8. नपुंसक 9. नक्षत्र 10. नक्र and 11. नाक।

Terms: नुट् Augment

The participle affix शतृ (अत्-अन्त्) does not take the augment नुम् after a reduplicate अङ्ग (stem).

Terms: नुम् augment

The गुण is not substituted for the penultimate light इक् vowel in the reduplicated form of a root, before a सार्वधातुक affix beginning with a vowel and having an indicatory प्।

Terms: गुण
